title: Apartment 93, Temple Gardens, Dublin 9
description:
Brand-New iBuild Refurbishment

Stunning 2-Bedroom, 2-Bathroom Apartment | Brand-New Refurbishment | Fully Furnished | Ready for Immediate Occupation

iLiv Property Management is delighted to present this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in Dublin 9, which has just undergone a complete refurbishment by our construction division, iBuild.

The property has been comprehensively upgraded throughout and is being presented to the rental market in turnkey condition, with a fresh, contemporary finish, new furnishings and modern fixtures and fittings.

Accommodation

The apartment offers a well-designed and spacious layout comprising two generous bedrooms and two bathrooms.

The main living accommodation is bright, modern and comfortable, with plenty of space for both living and dining. The property has been designed with everyday functionality in mind while maintaining a clean, high-quality finish throughout.

The newly fitted kitchen provides excellent storage and worktop space together with modern appliances and contemporary cabinetry.

Both bedrooms are generously proportioned and will be fully furnished, with excellent storage provided. Having two bathrooms is a major benefit for a two-bedroom apartment, particularly for tenants sharing.

The bathrooms have been newly finished with modern sanitary ware, contemporary tiling and high-quality fixtures and fittings.

Brand-New iBuild Refurbishment

The refurbishment has been carried out by our own construction team, iBuild, allowing the property to be comprehensively prepared for its new tenancy.

The apartment benefits from:

Complete refurbishment throughout
2 spacious bedrooms
2 modern bathrooms
Brand-new contemporary finish
Newly fitted kitchen
Modern appliances
New flooring and decoration throughout
Fully furnished
Excellent bedroom storage
Bright and spacious living/dining accommodation
High-quality fixtures and fittings
Professionally cleaned and prepared
Turnkey condition
Ready for immediate occupation
 managed by iLiv Property Management
Excellent Dublin 9 Location

The property is ideally positioned in Dublin 9, providing convenient access to Dublin city centre and a wide range of employment, educational and recreational amenities.

The wider area offers an excellent selection of supermarkets, shops, cafés, restaurants, gyms and everyday services, while a number of established residential neighbourhoods and green spaces are within easy reach.

The location also provides convenient access towards Dublin Airport, the M50 and M1, making it particularly attractive for tenants who need connectivity around Dublin as well as into the city centre.

Public transport options in the wider Dublin 9 area provide regular connections towards the city centre and surrounding areas.
